full_judgment: 3. Respondent No.1 as the plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 36 of 1995 in the Court of the Senior Assistant Judge, Chhagalnaiya, Feni against the predecessor of the petitioners being defendant Nos.1 and 32 others for declaration of title and confirmation of possession in the "Kha" scheduled land and recovery of khash possession in the "Ga" scheduled land as described in the plaint. His case, in short, is that Aftab Bibi was the original owner of 1.72 acres of land under S.C. Khatian No. 32 of Mouza-Matua under Police Station- Chhagalnaiya, District-Feni. After death of Aftab Bibi, her land devolved upon three sons, namely, Abdur Rashid, Abdur Razzaque and Abdul Jabbar, who inherited the same in equal shares. Each of her three sons got 0.18 acre of land out of 0.54 acre of disputed plot No. 1793. While Abdur Rashid had been enjoying and possessing the said land died leaving behind two sons, namely, Osman Gani (defendant No.2) and Abul Khayer and four daughters, namely, Sadhan Bibi, Nurer Nessa, Atiquer Nessa and Amirer Nessa, who inherited their father's property according to the Muslim Personal Law. The sons and daughters of Abdur Rashid by a registered deed of sale dated 05.07.1967 sold 0.21 acre of land of the disputed plot No. 1793 and other land of other undisputed plots to defendant No. 20, Mahmuda Khatun. Defendant Nos. 2-20 are the heirs of late Adur Rashid and Abdul Jabbar died leaving behind Sultan Ahmed, who died leaving behind three cousins namely, Osman Gani, (defendant No. 2), Abul Khair and Cheru Miah and Abdur Razzaque died leaving behind a son, Cheru Miah, daughter Najumer Nessa and a wife. Cheru Miah died leaving behind daughter Halima Khatun (defendant No. 24), wife Faizer Nessa and sister Najumer Nessa. After that, Halima Khatun (defendant No. 24) sold 0.52 acre of land by a registered deed of sale dated 26.04.1978 to defendant No. 20 Mahmuda Khatun. Faizer Hessa died leaving behind defendant Nos. 24-26 and Abdul Gani who by a registered deed of sale dated 24.04.1978 sold his interest in the said property. Thus defendant No. 20 became owner of 0.28 acre of land in suit plot No. 1793 out of which, she sold 0.10 acre of land to defendant No. 27 said to be benamder of defendant No.1 After that by a registered deed of sale dated 02.08.1988 she sold 0.16 acre from suit plot No. 1793 to the plaintiff who got mutation in his name and had been enjoying and possessing the same. While the plaintiff was in possession of the same, defendant No.1 on 30.06.1995 dispossessed him from 0.10 acre of land described in 'Ga' schedule and threatened to dispossess him from remaining 0.06 acre of land described in schedule- ;Ka' which are part and parcel of 0.54 acre of land described in schedule- 'Ka'. Hence the plaintiff was constrained to file the suit for declaration of title and confirmation of possession.
